adapted_from.source_text:
Using the uploaded reference image of [PRODUCT], create a realistic lifestyle product photograph in [ENVIRONMENT].

Place the product naturally on [SURFACE] as if it is being used in a real everyday setting. Add only a small number of contextually relevant props, such as [PROP 1] and [PROP 2]. The props must support the product story without competing for attention.

Use soft natural window light from one side, realistic ambient shadows, shallow depth of field, and a warm but accurate color grade. Keep the product as the sharpest and most important object in the image.

The scene should appeal to [TARGET AUDIENCE] and communicate [BRAND MOOD].

Preserve the exact product shape, packaging, label, logo, color, material, and proportions. Do not redesign the product or add fake text.

Authentic lifestyle photography, editorial composition, natural textures, 4:5 aspect ratio.
